title: Integrated Molecular Docking and Dynamic Simulations Reveal Glycyrrhizic Acid Alleviates Allergic Rhinitis in Rats by Inhibiting the TLR4/NF-kappaB/IL-1beta Pathway.
authors: Huang, Jianquan; Ren, Xinyue; Chen, Xiaojin; Zheng, Xiang
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接和MD模拟研究甘草酸与TLR4/NF-kB通路蛋白结合，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法可迁移性有限，仅边缘相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Allergic rhinitis (AR) is a prevalent chronic inflammatory nasal disorder with suboptimal current therapies. Glycyrrhizic acid (GA), a bioactive triterpenoid from Glycyrrhiza uralensis, exerts well-documented antiinflammatory effects, and preliminary evidence indicates its efficacy in alleviating airway inflammation in AR models. However, two critical knowledge gaps remain unaddressed: whether GA directly binds to core proteins of the toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4)/nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-kappaB)/IL-1beta inflammatory pathway, and whether this binding mediates GA's therapeutic effects in AR have not been systematically verified by integrated computational and in vivo experiments. METHODS: An ovalbumin (OVA)-induced AR rat model was established. GA was administered intranasally for seven consecutive days. Behavioral observations, histopathological examination, and serum cytokine detection were performed to evaluate AR-related symptoms and immune imbalance. Molecular docking was employed to assess the binding affinity between GA and four key proteins in the TLR4 pathway (TLR4, myeloid differentiation primary response 88 [MyD88], NF-kappaB, and IL-1beta). About 100 ns molecular dynamics (MD) simulations were further conducted to validate the stability of the GA-protein complexes. Immunohistochemistry and RT-qPCR were used to verify the expression of pathway-related proteins and cytokines in nasal mucosal tissues. RESULTS: GA significantly reduced sneezing, rhinorrhea, and nasal mucosal pathological damage in AR rats. It restored the T helper 1 (Th1)/Th2 immune balance by suppressing Th2 cytokines (IL-4 and IL-13) and enhancing Th1 cytokines (interferon-gamma [IFN-gamma] and IL-2). Molecular docking results showed that GA bound strongly to all four target proteins, with the highest affinity for IL-1beta (-9.3 kcal/mol) and TLR4 (-7.6 kcal/mol). MD simulations confirmed the stable conformational dynamics of the GA-IL-1beta and GA-TLR4 complexes. In vivo experiments further demonstrated that GA significantly downregulated the expression of TLR4, MyD88, NF-kappaB, and IL-1beta in nasal mucosa and reduced the levels of downstream proinflammatory cytokines (TNF-alpha and IL-6). CONCLUSIONS: GA alleviates AR symptoms by directly binding to core proteins of the TLR4/NF-kappaB/IL-1beta pathway, inhibiting pathway activation, restoring Th1/Th2 immune balance, and suppressing inflammatory responses. This study provides structural and functional evidence supporting GA as a promising targeted therapeutic candidate for AR.
abstract_zh: 背景：过敏性鼻炎（AR）是一种常见的慢性炎症性鼻部疾病，目前治疗方法尚不理想。甘草酸（GA）是从乌拉尔甘草（Glycyrrhiza uralensis）中提取的一种具有生物活性的三萜类化合物，其抗炎作用已有充分文献记载，初步证据表明其在AR模型中能有效缓解气道炎症。然而，两个关键知识空白仍未解决：GA是否直接结合toll样受体4（TLR4）/核因子-kappa B（NF-kappaB）/IL-1beta炎症通路的核心蛋白，以及这种结合是否介导GA在AR中的治疗作用，尚未通过整合计算和体内实验进行系统验证。方法：建立卵清蛋白（OVA）诱导的AR大鼠模型。连续七天经鼻给予GA。通过行为观察、组织病理学检查和血清细胞因子检测评估AR相关症状和免疫失衡。采用分子对接评估GA与TLR4通路中四个关键蛋白（TLR4、髓样分化初级反应88 [MyD88]、NF-kappaB和IL-1beta）之间的结合亲和力。进一步进行约100 ns的分子动力学（MD）模拟以验证GA-蛋白复合物的稳定性。使用免疫组织化学和RT-qPCR验证鼻黏膜组织中通路相关蛋白和细胞因子的表达。结果：GA显著减少AR大鼠的喷嚏、流涕和鼻黏膜病理损伤。它通过抑制Th2细胞因子（IL-4和IL-13）并增强Th1细胞因子（干扰素-gamma [IFN-gamma]和IL-2）来恢复T辅助1（Th1）/Th2免疫平衡。分子对接结果显示，GA与所有四个靶蛋白均强烈结合，其中对IL-1beta（-9.3 kcal/mol）和TLR4（-7.6 kcal/mol）的亲和力最高。MD模拟确认了GA-IL-1beta和GA-TLR4复合物的稳定构象动态。体内实验进一步证明，GA显著下调鼻黏膜中TLR4、MyD88、NF-kappaB和IL-1beta的表达，并降低下游促炎细胞因子（TNF-alpha和IL-6）的水平。结论：GA通过直接结合TLR4/NF-kappaB/IL-1beta通路的核心蛋白，抑制通路激活，恢复Th1/Th2免疫平衡，并抑制炎症反应，从而缓解AR症状。本研究提供了结构和功能证据，支持GA作为AR的有前景的靶向治疗候选药物。
